_about: Text the simulation core uses: journal lines, notices, results, rivers, roads, breakdowns, money, dates.
journal.start: The {family} family make ready to leave Grahamstown.
journal.paid_in_sheep: {who} was paid this month's wage in sheep ({n}).
journal.slaughtered_cow: With the sheep gone, a cow was slaughtered. Some of the meat was eaten fresh and the rest cut into strips and dried as biltong.
journal.gave_up: With no oxen left to pull the wagon, the family gave up the trek.
notice.servant_left: {who} has left the party to find work elsewhere.
notice.no_water: There was no water today. People and oxen are suffering.
notice.ox_died: An exhausted ox lay down and would not rise again.
notice.near_death: {who} is gravely ill and very weak. Rest, medicine and good food may still save them.
notice.wages_unpaid: There is no money to pay {who} this month.
notice.food_low: Food is running low. Less than a week remains.
notice.water_low: The water vats are nearly empty, and this is dry country.
role.head: head of the family
lock.too_shallow: Not enough water to float a wagon
lock.need_tallow: Needs 10 lb of tallow to caulk the wagon
lock.english_only: Only the English families know the settlers here
lock.not_trusted: The trekkers do not trust you enough yet
lock.need_meal: Needs half a muid of meal
landmark.rested: You rest a day. People mend clothes, the oxen graze, and the children play.
river.depth.shallow: The {river} runs low and clear over the stones of the drift. About {ft} feet deep.
river.depth.waist: The {river} is about {ft} feet deep at the drift, up to a man's knees or waist, and the current is steady.
river.depth.deep: The {river} is running deep, about {ft} feet, and brown with mud. Too deep to ford safely.
river.depth.flood: The {river} is in flood: {ft} feet or more, fast and full of driftwood.
river.float: Caulk the wagon with tallow and float it over
river.carry: Carry the goods over first, then take the empty wagon (a day)
river.wait: Wait a day for the river to drop
river.waited: You wait on the bank for a day and look at the water again.
river.safe: The oxen lean into their yokes, and the wagon comes up the far bank safely.
river.trouble.goods: Halfway across the wagon lurches, and water pours over the side.
river.trouble.oxen: The current takes the front oxen off their feet.
river.trouble.wagon: A wheel catches on a hidden rock and the wagon slews; something cracks.
river.trouble.person: {who} is swept off their feet in the current. {helper} wades in and drags them to the bank.
route.title: The road divides
route.body: There is more than one way north from here. Which road will you take?
route.west.label: The western road, by Cradock and Colesberg ({miles} miles to Cradock)
route.west.advice: The western road goes through colonial towns where you can buy supplies, but past Cradock it crosses the dry Karoo. Carry water.
route.east.label: The eastern road, by the Tarka and the Stormberg ({miles} miles to the Tarka)
route.east.advice: The eastern road is shorter, but it climbs into the mountains, where nights are cold. There are few stores. Retief's people went this way in March.
route.direct.label: Straight on to Thaba Nchu ({miles} miles)
route.direct.advice: The direct road to Thaba Nchu is the shortest way.
route.philippolis.label: By Philippolis ({miles} miles)
route.philippolis.advice: Philippolis is a Griqua town a little out of the way. There will be trade and news there.
breakdown.title: The wagon is broken
breakdown.body: With a crack like a gunshot, the {part} gives way. The wagon cannot go on like this.
breakdown.rig: Lash it together with riems and timber (two days)
breakdown.spare.done: The spare is fitted, and the wagon is as good as new.
breakdown.mend.done: The {part} is mended. It will hold for now.
breakdown.rig.done: The {part} is lashed together. It is not strong; go carefully.
stranded.title: Stranded
stranded.body: With only {n} oxen left, the wagon cannot move.
stranded.wait: Wait and send for help (three days)
stranded.yoke: Break young cattle from the herd to the yoke (a day)
stranded.yoked: You put {n} young cattle in the span between the trained oxen. They struggle and bellow at first, but soon find it is no use and pull with the rest.
stranded.bought: A passing party sells you {n} oxen for {cost}.
stranded.lent: Trekker friends lend you {n} oxen to go on with.
stranded.no_money: A party passes with oxen to spare, but you cannot pay their price.
stranded.nobody: Three days pass, and nobody comes.
advice.oxen: "You'll want more oxen than that. A wagon needs a full span, and you will lose some on the road."
advice.spare: "Take a spare wheel or axle. There is no wagonmaker north of the Orange."
advice.water: "Carry water vats. The Karoo past Cradock can be dry for days."
advice.food: "That is not food enough for the road ahead. Meal, biltong, beskuit."
advice.medicine: "A few doses of medicine might save a life out there."
advice.ok: "You look well found. God speed you on the road."
